plain_english_policy: Aid should be granted only when it directly serves U.S. security interests, not for humanitarian or developmental purposes.
evidence_quote: **b) Support the United States granting aid to countries when it is in the security interests of the United States.**
review_reason: The phrasing leans toward a narrow, strategic (conservative/realist) justification for aid but does not explicitly exclude humanitarian or developmental aid. Context-dependent—could be interpreted as either restrictive (if implying aid is only for security) or permissive (if allowing other justifications under 'security interests').
